verses.he: לְדָוִד אַל־תִּתְחַר בַּמְּרֵעִים אַל־תְּקַנֵּא בְּעֹשֵׂי עַוְלָה׃
verses.en: [A Psalm] of David. Fret not thyself because of evil-doers, neither be thou envious against them that work unrighteousness.

verses.he: כִּי כֶחָצִיר מְהֵרָה יִמָּלוּ וּכְיֶרֶק דֶּשֶׁא יִבּוֹלוּן׃
verses.en: For they shall soon wither like the grass, and fade as the green herb.

verses.he: בְּטַח בַּיהוָה וַעֲשֵׂה־טוֹב שְׁכָן־אֶרֶץ וּרְעֵה אֱמוּנָה׃
verses.en: Trust in the LORD, and do good; dwell in the land, and cherish faithfulness.

verses.he: וְהִתְעַנַּג עַל־יְהוָה וְיִתֶּן־לְךָ מִשְׁאֲלֹת לִבֶּךָ׃
verses.en: So shalt thou delight thyself in the LORD; and He shall give thee the petitions of thy heart.

verses.he: גּוֹל עַל־יְהוָה דַּרְכֶּךָ וּבְטַח עָלָיו וְהוּא יַעֲשֶׂה׃
verses.en: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in Him, and He will bring it to pass.

verses.he: וְהוֹצִיא כָאוֹר צִדְקֶךָ וּמִשְׁפָּטֶךָ כַּצָּהֳרָיִם׃
verses.en: And He will make thy righteousness to go forth as the light, and thy right as the noonday.

verses.he: דּוֹם לַיהוָה וְהִתְחוֹלֵל לוֹ אַל־תִּתְחַר בְּמַצְלִיחַ דַּרְכּוֹ בְּאִישׁ עֹשֶׂה מְזִמּוֹת׃
verses.en: Resign thyself unto the LORD, and wait patiently for Him; fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.

verses.he: הֶרֶף מֵאַף וַעֲזֹב חֵמָה אַל־תִּתְחַר אַךְ־לְהָרֵעַ׃
verses.en: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath; fret not thyself, it tendeth only to evil-doing.

verses.he: כִּי־מְרֵעִים יִכָּרֵתוּן וְקֹוֵי יְהוָה הֵמָּה יִירְשׁוּ־אָרֶץ׃
verses.en: For evil-doers shall be cut off; but those that wait for the LORD, they shall inherit the land.

verses.he: וְעוֹד מְעַט וְאֵין רָשָׁע וְהִתְבּוֹנַנְתָּ עַל־מְקוֹמוֹ וְאֵינֶנּוּ׃
verses.en: And yet a little while, and the wicked is no more; yea, thou shalt look well at his place, and he is not.

verses.he: וַעֲנָוִים יִירְשׁוּ־אָרֶץ וְהִתְעַנְּגוּ עַל־רֹב שָׁלוֹם׃
verses.en: But the humble shall inherit the land, and delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

verses.he: זֹמֵם רָשָׁע לַצַּדִּיק וְחֹרֵק עָלָיו שִׁנָּיו׃
verses.en: The wicked plotteth against the righteous, and gnasheth at him with his teeth.

verses.he: אֲדֹנָי יִשְׂחַק־לוֹ כִּי־רָאָה כִּי־יָבֹא יוֹמוֹ׃
verses.en: The Lord doth laugh at him; for He seeth that his day is coming.

verses.he: חֶרֶב פָּתְחוּ רְשָׁעִים וְדָרְכוּ קַשְׁתָּם לְהַפִּיל עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן לִטְבוֹחַ יִשְׁרֵי־דָרֶךְ׃
verses.en: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow; to cast down the poor and needy, to slay such as are upright in the way;

verses.he: חַרְבָּם תָּבוֹא בְלִבָּם וְקַשְּׁתוֹתָם תִּשָּׁבַרְנָה׃
verses.en: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

verses.he: טוֹב־מְעַט לַצַּדִּיק מֵהֲמוֹן רְשָׁעִים רַבִּים׃
verses.en: Better is a little that the righteous hath than the abundance of many wicked.

verses.he: כִּי זְרוֹעוֹת רְשָׁעִים תִּשָּׁבַרְנָה וְסוֹמֵךְ צַדִּיקִים יְהוָה׃
verses.en: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken; but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.

verses.he: יוֹדֵעַ יְהוָה יְמֵי תְמִימִם וְנַחֲלָתָם לְעוֹלָם תִּהְיֶה׃
verses.en: The LORD knoweth the days of them that are wholehearted; and their inheritance shall be for ever.

verses.he: לֹא־יֵבֹשׁוּ בְּעֵת רָעָה וּבִימֵי רְעָבוֹן יִשְׂבָּעוּ׃
verses.en: They shall not be ashamed in the time of evil; and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

verses.he: כִּי רְשָׁעִים יֹאבֵדוּ וְאֹיְבֵי יְהוָה כִּיקַר כָּרִים כָּלוּ בֶעָשָׁן כָּלוּ׃
verses.en: For the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD shall be as the fat of lambs— They shall pass away in smoke, they shall pass away.

verses.he: לֹוֶה רָשָׁע וְלֹא יְשַׁלֵּם וְצַדִּיק חוֹנֵן וְנוֹתֵן׃
verses.en: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not; but the righteous dealeth graciously, and giveth.

verses.he: כִּי מְבֹרָכָיו יִירְשׁוּ אָרֶץ וּמְקֻלָּלָיו יִכָּרֵתוּ׃
verses.en: For such as are blessed of Him shall inherit the land; and they that are cursed of Him shall be cut off.

verses.he: מֵיְהוָה מִצְעֲדֵי־גֶבֶר כּוֹנָנוּ וְדַרְכּוֹ יֶחְפָּץ׃
verses.en: It is of the LORD that a man's goings are established; and He delighted in his way.

verses.he: כִּי־יִפֹּל לֹא־יוּטָל כִּי־יְהוָה סוֹמֵךְ יָדוֹ׃
verses.en: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down; for the LORD upholdeth his hand.

verses.he: נַעַר הָיִיתִי גַּם־זָקַנְתִּי וְלֹא־רָאִיתִי צַדִּיק נֶעֱזָב וְזַרְעוֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ־לָחֶם׃
verses.en: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.

verses.he: כָּל־הַיּוֹם חוֹנֵן וּמַלְוֶה וְזַרְעוֹ לִבְרָכָה׃
verses.en: All the day long he dealeth graciously, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.

verses.he: סוּר מֵרָע וַעֲשֵׂה־טוֹב וּשְׁכֹן לְעוֹלָם׃
verses.en: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.

verses.he: כִּי יְהוָה אֹהֵב מִשְׁפָּט וְלֹא־יַעֲזֹב אֶת־חֲסִידָיו לְעוֹלָם נִשְׁמָרוּ וְזֶרַע רְשָׁעִים נִכְרָת׃
verses.en: For the LORD loveth justice, And forsaketh not His saints; they are preserved for ever; but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

verses.he: צַדִּיקִים יִירְשׁוּ־אָרֶץ וְיִשְׁכְּנוּ לָעַד עָלֶיהָ׃
verses.en: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.

verses.he: פִּי־צַדִּיק יֶהְגֶּה חָכְמָה וּלְשׁוֹנוֹ תְּדַבֵּר מִשְׁפָּט׃
verses.en: The mouth of the righteous uttereth wisdom, and his tongue speaketh justice.

verses.he: תּוֹרַת אֱלֹהָיו בְּלִבּוֹ לֹא תִמְעַד אֲשֻׁרָיו׃
verses.en: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps slide.

verses.he: צוֹפֶה רָשָׁע לַצַּדִּיק וּמְבַקֵּשׁ לַהֲמִיתוֹ׃
verses.en: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.

verses.he: יְהוָה לֹא־יַעַזְבֶנּוּ בְיָדוֹ וְלֹא יַרְשִׁיעֶנּוּ בְּהִשָּׁפְטוֹ׃
verses.en: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor suffer him to be condemned when he is judged.

verses.he: קַוֵּה אֶל־יְהוָה וּשְׁמֹר דַּרְכּוֹ וִירוֹמִמְךָ לָרֶשֶׁת אָרֶץ בְּהִכָּרֵת רְשָׁעִים תִּרְאֶה׃
verses.en: Wait for the LORD, and keep His way, and He will exalt thee to inherit the land; when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.

verses.he: רָאִיתִי רָשָׁע עָרִיץ וּמִתְעָרֶה כְּאֶזְרָח רַעֲנָן׃
verses.en: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a leafy tree in its native soil.

verses.he: וַיַּעֲבֹר וְהִנֵּה אֵינֶנּוּ וָאֲבַקְשֵׁהוּ וְלֹא נִמְצָא׃
verses.en: But one passed by, and, lo, he was not; yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

verses.he: שְׁמָר־תָּם וּרְאֵה יָשָׁר כִּי־אַחֲרִית לְאִישׁ שָׁלוֹם׃
verses.en: Mark the man of integrity, and behold the upright; for there is a future for the man of peace.

verses.he: וּפֹשְׁעִים נִשְׁמְדוּ יַחְדָּו אַחֲרִית רְשָׁעִים נִכְרָתָה׃
verses.en: But transgressors shall be destroyed together; the future of the wicked shall be cut off.

verses.he: וּתְשׁוּעַת צַדִּיקִים מֵיְהוָה מָעוּזָּם בְּעֵת צָרָה׃
verses.en: But the salvation of the righteous is of the LORD; He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.

verses.he: וַיַּעְזְרֵם יְהוָה וַיְפַלְּטֵם יְפַלְּטֵם מֵרְשָׁעִים וְיוֹשִׁיעֵם כִּי־חָסוּ בוֹ׃
verses.en: And the LORD helpeth them, and delivereth them; He delivereth them from the wicked, and saveth them, because they have taken refuge in Him.
